calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-26-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and Two Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioners Rui Duo Zhen and Ying Da Liu were present in pro per as Guardians ad litem for the minors, Jia Yu Zhen and Jia Feng Zhen.
Allen Li was placed under oath and served as Cantonese speaking interpreter for petitioners.
Petitioners were placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Rachel Ruiduo Zhen.

Additionally, the Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to: Kelly Jiayu Zhen and Kevin Jiafeng Liu.

Decree Changing Names was submitted to and signed by the Court.
